git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.onError.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for onError on non-Error rejections

Define DONE for HALEngine#95 with executable acceptance tests that verify:
- onError is called for string rejections with wrapped Error and cause
- onError is called for plain object rejections with wrapped Error and cause
- onError is called for undefined rejections with wrapped Error and cause
- onError receives Error instances without wrapping
- Caller receives original rejection unchanged

These tests fail until the catch handler is modified to call onError for
every rejection, wrapping non-Error values in an Error with the original
as cause, while rethrowing the original value to the caller.
